column1: # Every agent declares exactly one recursive placeholder root. Existing emit/root-shared file surfaces are scanned exactly from surface rows; planned, preserve, and read-shared paths are outside this emitted-output check.
# Exclusive roots MUST be strict parents of every emitted directory. Bounded roots MUST equal one shared emitted directory.
# Shared vendor namespaces use bounded subroots; broad .agents and .github roots are FORBIDDEN.
